cards.heading: What is a trigger?
cards.body: A trigger is any situation, emotion, person, or environment that creates an urge to use. Knowing yours gives you power over them.

cards.heading: The 4 trigger categories
cards.body: Most triggers fall into: Emotional (stress, boredom, anxiety), Social (certain friends, parties), Environmental (places, smells), and Temporal (end of day, weekends).

cards.heading: Avoid vs. prepare
cards.body: Some triggers you can avoid entirely. Others you can't — but you can prepare a plan for when they hit.

cards.prompt: Write down your top 3 triggers. For each one, is it avoidable or something you need a coping plan for?
